lines.text: Romans, countrymen, and lovers, hear me for my cause; and be silent, that you may hear. Believe me for mine honour, and have respect to mine honour, that you may believe. Censure me in your wisdom, and awake your senses, that you may the better judge. If there be any in this assembly, any dear friend of Caesar's, to him I say that Brutus' love to Caesar was no less than his. If then that friend demand why Brutus rose against Caesar, this is my answer: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more. Had you rather Caesar were living, and die all slaves, than that Caesar were dead, to live all free men? As Caesar loved me, I weep for him; as he was fortunate, I rejoice at it; as he was valiant, I honour him; but, as he was ambitious, I slew him. There is tears, for his love; joy for his fortune; honour for his valour; and death, for his ambition. Who is here so base, that would be a bondman? If any, speak; for him have I offended. Who is here so rude, that would not be a Roman? If any, speak; for him have I offended. Who is here so vile, that will not love his country? If any, speak; for him have I offended. I pause for a reply.

lines.plainText: Where is he

lines.text: He and Lepidus are at Caesar's house.
lines.plainText: He and Lepidus are at Caesar's house

lines.text: And thither will I straight to visit him.
lines.plainText: And thither will I straight to visit him

lines.text: He comes upon a wish. Fortune is merry,
lines.plainText: He comes upon a wish Fortune is merry

lines.text: And in this mood will give us anything.
lines.plainText: And in this mood will give us anything

lines.text: I heard him say Brutus and Cassius
lines.plainText: I heard him say Brutus and Cassius

lines.text: Are rid like madmen through the gates of Rome.
lines.plainText: Are rid like madmen through the gates of Rome

lines.text: Belike they had some notice of the people,
lines.plainText: Belike they had some notice of the people

lines.text: How I had moved them. Bring me to Octavius.
lines.plainText: How I had moved them Bring me to Octavius
